title: Personio jobs input
description: Read one or more public Personio boards and get every open position.

boards.title: Boards
boards.description: Personio company names, or full career site URLs. Example: ottonova, stark, https://ottonova.jobs.personio.de/. Duplicates are read once.

includeDetails.title: Include descriptions
includeDetails.description: Put the position description into each row. The feed already carries it, so this only decides whether it lands in your dataset (rows get large).

descriptionFormat.title: Description format
descriptionFormat.description: html keeps the employer markup as it is; text strips tags, decodes entities and keeps the section headings. Ignored when includeDetails is off.

language.title: Feed language
language.description: Two letter code the board should answer in, for example de or en. Empty means the employer's default, which is what the career page shows. A board that has no translation falls back to its own language.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Max positions per board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: How many matching positions to process per board. 0 means no limit. Positions past the limit are counted, never charged.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma separated phrases; a position matches when any phrase occurs in its title, department, occupation, category or the employer's keyword list. Example: engineer, data scientist. Empty means no keyword filter.

department.title: Department contains
department.description: Case insensitive substring of the department.

category.title: Recruiting category contains
category.description: Case insensitive substring of the recruiting category the employer picked.

occupationCategory.title: Occupation category contains
occupationCategory.description: Personio's own occupation category, for example accounting_and_finance.

city.title: Office contains
city.description: Case insensitive substring of any office of the position, not only the main one.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep positions whose office name or description says remote or homeoffice. The feed carries no remote flag, so this reads the text the employer wrote.

createdAfter.title: Created after
createdAfter.description: Only positions created on or after this date. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: How long one board request may take before it is counted as unreadable.
